Subject: Reference checks and two quick scheduling questions

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for interviewing with the team — we’re wrapping up final interviews and would like to run two short reference calls (20–30 min) this week or early next week. Could you please: 

1) Share two people who can speak to your work (title and relationship + best phone number/email).
2) Let us know any blackout times (blocks when you prefer we not call).

We generally prefer one former manager and one peer, but any combination you think will give the best context is fine. I’ve attached a short reference-question guide (Ref_Check_Guide.pdf) so your refs know what to expect.

Target timeline: have calls completed and notes in the candidate folder by Friday 12/3. If that’s tight, tell me and we’ll extend.

Best,

Subject: Re: Schedule confirmed: James 10:00am Wed; assigning note-taker (notes attached)

Thanks team — I took notes on the James call and uploaded a short summary to the candidate folder. Key takeaways: 

- Role/context: Olivia led product for Acme’s SMB analytics line; highly cross-functional, owned roadmap messaging.
- Strengths: clear prioritization framework, excellent stakeholder communication (gave two examples where she re-aligned engineering and sales on scope), strong ownership of launch metrics.
- Concerns: limited exposure to enterprise procurement cycles (has less direct experience negotiating legal/ procurement).
- Fit: Monica recommends moving Olivia forward to final leadership interview with a focus on procurement exposure; suggests a work sample exercise on vendor selection.

I’ve pasted the raw notes below and attached the cleaned doc (OG_ref_notes.docx).

-- Raw notes (excerpt) --
James: Worked with Olivia 2019–2022 on launches A & B. She handled roadmap tradeoffs when we had conflicting revenue vs product goals. Example: prioritized a smaller scoped MVP that landed 12% higher retention in Q1. Good independent judgment.

Action items: Stephanie to follow up with Lisa for availability and add Monica’s recommendation to the candidate packet.

Monica Patel
Director of Product | Redwood Inference
